request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Pavise Poacher".

Creative brief
Name: Pavise Poacher
Collection: Ironroad Marauders. Organized highway raiders who turn practical medieval weapons, shields, traps, chains, and stolen supplies into disciplined projectile patterns.
Core concept: A directional defender that alternates between blocking and crossbow fire.
Body and silhouette: Crouched humanoid mostly hidden behind a tall rectangular pavise shield.
Signature features: Painted animal-skull emblem, crossbow extending around the shield edge, and heavy boots.
Palette and materials: Faded forest green, raw wood, dull iron, and dirty beige.
Movement personality: Cautious, disciplined, and slow to reposition.
Attack concept: Faces the player with its shield raised, then visibly leans out and fires a three-bolt fan from the exposed side.
Directional details: The crossbow is always operated from the shield’s right edge.
Avoid: Towering knight, modern riot shield, perfectly clean military equipment.
